requirement_vague: Ensure requesting password recovery works and an email is actually sent to the correct recipient (verify via mailcatcher at localhost:1080).
requirement_precise: Register a normal user with email test15@example.com via POST /api/v1/users/signup. Then request a password recovery email via POST /api/v1/password-recovery/{email}. Verify that the API responds with HTTP status code 200, a JSON message 'Password recovery email sent', and that an email was actually sent to the correct recipient via the mailcatcher service (verify via GET http://localhost:1080/messages).

omissions.reasoning: The code defines routes for signup, login, users, and items, but there is no route matching POST /api/v1/password-recovery/{email} or any password recovery endpoint at all.

omissions.description: No implementation returning HTTP 200 with JSON message 'Password recovery email sent' for password recovery requests.
omissions.reasoning: Because the password recovery endpoint is absent, the required success response format and status code are not implemented anywhere in the code.

omissions.description: No email is sent for password recovery, including no verification-targeted delivery to the requested recipient.
omissions.reasoning: The service contains no SMTP, mailer, HTTP call, or any outbound interaction to send a password recovery email. There is no logic that would send an email to test15@example.com or any other recipient.

omissions.description: No interaction with mailcatcher at localhost:1080 to support verification that the recovery email was sent.
omissions.reasoning: The code has no outbound calls or mail configuration referencing localhost:1080 or mailcatcher, so the required verifiable email delivery path is absent.
